name: narubook-workspace
description: Monorepo workspace for NaruBook Social Media Network

scripts.install-all: cmd.exe /c "npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
